description: This file defines the interface for a SocketServer class and a Response struct, providing methods for socket communication, including opening connections, running threads, sending and receiving messages, and managing internal state.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A data structure representing a response with a channel ID and JSON content.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: A class encapsulating socket server operations, including connection management, message sending, and threading.

methods.name: Response(uint32_t channel, const string& json_str)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Response with channel ID and JSON string.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to the specified address and port, with a callback for responses.

methods.name: SendInvoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke message with a channel ID, token, and JSON payload.

methods.name: SendAttach
methods.description: Sends an attach or detach command for a channel.

methods.name: SendExit
methods.description: Sends an exit command to the server.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a response into the provided Response object.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the socket.

methods.name: RunThreadFunc
methods.description: Static function used as the thread entry point.
